select a.equipment_cd ,c.make_no ,a.equipment_name ,i.item_name ,b.order_qty ,b.order_qty ,b.proc_status ,b1.work_proc_id from tb_equipment_mst a left join TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC b on b.proc_cd = 'PRC002' and b.work_equipment_Cd = a.equipment_cd and b.proc_status = '21' left join TB_WORK_ORDER_BATCH c on c.work_batch_id = b.work_batch_id and c.batch_status = '21' left join tb_item_mst i on i.item_cd = b.item_cd left join TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC b1 on b1.proc_cd = 'PRC001' and b1.work_batch_id = b.work_batch_id
where a.storage_cd in ( select storage_cd from tb_storage_mst where area_cd = #{areaCd}) and a.prod_yn ='Y' and a.use_yn ='Y' order by a.equipment_cd

select b.make_no ,i.item_name ,a.order_qty ,a.work_proc_id ,(select proc_status from TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC where proc_cd = 'PRC002' and work_batch_id = a.work_batch_id) as proc_status ,a.work_batch_id from TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC a join TB_WORK_ORDER_BATCH b on a.work_batch_id = b.work_batch_id and b.batch_status = #{batchStatus} join TB_WORK_ORDER_MST c on c.work_order_id = a.work_order_id join tb_item_mst i on i.item_cd = a.item_cd where a.proc_order_date between #{strDate} and #{endDate} and a.proc_cd = #{procCd} and c.area_cd = #{areaCd} order by a.proc_order_date desc , b.work_batch_id desc

select a.work_proc_id ,a.work_batch_id ,a.work_order_id ,b.area_cd ,a.item_cd ,a.proc_cd ,case when b.area_cd = 'A001' then 'WS103' when b.area_cd = 'A002' then 'WA102' else '' end as storage_cd ,a.test_no from TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC a join TB_WORK_ORDER_MST b on b.work_order_id = a.work_order_id where a.proc_cd = 'PRC002' and a.end_yn ='N' and a.work_batch_id = ( select work_batch_id from TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC a where work_proc_id = #{workProcId} ) and a.proc_status != '99'
select COUNT(*) as cnt from tb_make_etc where work_proc_id = #{workProcId}
mapper.insert: insert into tb_make_etc (work_proc_id, item_cd, maker, reg_id ,upd_id ) values (#{workProcId}, #{itemCd}, #{maker}, #{userId} , #{userId} )
